correctness.rationale: For A=F_q[x_1,...,x_d]/m³, d≥1 any prime-power q, split radical m=V⊕W with W=Sym²V, h=dim W. Every proper ideal projects to U≤V, dim U=r, intersects W in C containing VU; conversely every such pair and linear graph map U→W/C determines a unique ideal. W/VU≅Sym²(V/U) of dimension b_r=binom(d-r+1,2) in all characteristics including 2. Gaussian choices [d r]_q[b_r j]_q q^{r(b_r-j)} give dimension r+h-b_r+j. Nakayama μ(I)=dim I/mI=r+j, and A contributes unique X^{1+d+h}Y. Principal count follows from r+j=1. Independent exhaustive RREF enumeration of 374 subspaces of five-dimensional F2 radical for d=2 checked ideal closure under x,y and μ via product-span rank; got exactly 27 ideals with the asserted eight bivariate coefficients. General argument is exact, not inferred from finite experiment.
